brief:
Israel's military operations have killed 300 Palestinian children over the past 300 days, according to UNICEF, the United Nations children's agency reported by Zeteo. The figures reflect mounting casualties among Gaza's civilian population as the conflict extends into its eleventh month.

The Israeli military has also destroyed warehouses storing medicine in Gaza, compounding existing shortages of medical supplies across the territory. Healthcare workers report critical gaps in essential medications and equipment needed to treat wounded patients and manage chronic disease. The destruction of medical stockpiles comes as hospitals and clinics struggle to maintain basic operations under bombardment.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: UNICEF reports 300 Palestinian children killed in 300 days of war
